title: See, the Conquering Hero Comes (theme)
composer: G. F. Handel, arr. Alex Attard Music
source: Melody checked on 18 Nov 2026 against the hymn-tune form of Handel's chorus ("Thine Be the Glory") as notated in Wikipedia, moved from D to G. The left hand is our own simple setting.
print_source: Melody from the chorus in Handel's Judas Maccabaeus, in its hymn-tune form, moved to G. Arranged for piano by Alex Attard Music.
